uncertain_sources: The opening signature discussion is self-corrected and noisy in the ASR. The chapter keeps the background metric abstract and uses signature-independent statements wherever possible.
The lecture gives the linearized Ricci tensor only schematically. The chapter preserves that level of derivation and does not claim that the full indexed formula was written on the board.
The exact gauge conditions are not derived in the lecture. The chapter states their physical effect and the resulting transverse-traceless form without fabricating a missing gauge calculation.
The phrase around 01:29:45--01:30:08 is corrupted beyond recovery. The chapter retains the continuous, intelligible response about varying the metric and constructing the curvature scalar.
The quoted direct-detection status is historical to the 2012 lecture and is identified as such.
The binary-pulsar frequency exchange contains an on-the-spot correction. The chapter retains the corrected 7.75-hour orbital period rather than the withdrawn millisecond estimate.
The Einstein-Hilbert action is normalized in a standard convention and uses an absolute determinant so the Lorentzian measure remains consistent across signature choices.
